raw:
@q query
  select ?age1
  select ?age2
  where all
    match
      relation "be old"
      role subject "parintele Ilie de la Tismana"
      role object ?age1
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be old"
      role subject "parintele Serafim de la Lainici"
      role object ?age2
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?age1 above ?age2
